title: relaybay policy layer
description: One layer of the relaybay policy: the global file, a project layer or an environment layer. Every key is optional; a lower layer overrides the upper one.

preset.description: Built-in starting point under every other layer. Global layer only.

levels.description: Agents' permission level per environment kind, used where an environment sets none itself.

mode.description: off: no checks; log: live journal only, no messages; warn: a warning to the agent; block: deny (ask stays ask in every mode but log).

disable.description: Built-in mutating rules to switch off, by id (replaces the list).

disable+.description: Rule ids to add to the inherited list.

disable-.description: Rule ids to remove from the inherited list.

patterns+.description: Patterns to add; one with an inherited id replaces it.

patterns-.description: Ids of inherited patterns to remove.

approvals.description: Which agent actions need the owner's approval on the board (one approval allows one matching call). Independent of the guard's mode.

commit.description: git commit needs an approval naming its branch (default false).

push.description: git push needs an approval naming its branch (default true).

merge.description: gh pr merge needs an approval naming the pull request (default true).

test.description: A change on a test stand (deploy, SQL, kubectl, ssh with a write) needs an approval (default true).

live.description: A change on a live stand always needs an approval: only true is accepted, a policy cannot drop it.

valid_minutes.description: An approved approval not used within this many minutes expires (default 120).

desktop.description: Check desktop sessions too, not only the program's runs (default false).

disable.description: Built-in action patterns to switch off, by id (replaces the list).

disable+.description: Pattern ids to add to the inherited list.

disable-.description: Pattern ids to remove from the inherited list.

ignore.description: Regular expressions: a command segment that matches one is never an action that needs an approval (replaces the list).

secrets.description: What counts as a secret in environment fields, access entries and proposals.

disable.description: Built-in secret detectors to switch off, by id (replaces the list). The journal still masks them.

disable+.description: Detector ids to add to the inherited list.

disable-.description: Detector ids to remove from the inherited list.

allow.description: Regular expressions: a value (or a detected secret) that matches one whole is accepted (replaces the list).

test_secrets.description: Whether access fields may hold harmless test values marked {"value": "...", "test": true}. There is no live key: never on live.

expose_test_secrets_to_agents.description: Show test secret values to agents in environments_get (otherwise only their names).

kindLevels.description: default: the level of the kind; a capability key: the level for that capability.

sign_in.description: Signing in and remembering the login.

id.description: Stable id, not one of the built-in rule ids.

capability.description: Capability whose level applies; null or absent: any identifier.

command.description: Optional: the command the change must follow in the same command segment.

change.description: What makes the call a change (case-insensitive).

description.description: Shown in the guard's reason, after "this looks like a".
